about: Tracks a pick-up whose item transfers are running. Added by PickUpExecutionSystem::ProcessTransferRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xD4A630, FUN_180d48510 default-constructs it) and updated by PickUpExecutionFinishedSystem::UpdateTrackComponents (EoCServer.dll+0xD47E60). Seen.py context: tree3 dialogue UND_PanicRoom_HiddenGnome.

evidence.says: UpdateTrackComponents reads *(int*)(element+0) of an 8-byte-stride storage and acts when it reaches 0. Live 1 (one transfer in flight).

UpdateTrackComponents: if byte +5 == 0x0E it is replaced by a new value; live 0x0E (default/pending result code of the pick-up result enum, same family as the 0x13/0x14 codes in PickUpExecutionFinishedSystem).
Live garbage d0 07; macOS default ctor stores one qword (str x0, [x23]).

open_questions: The storage read in UpdateTrackComponents is assumed to be this component's (8-byte stride matches); the enum behind Result is not named.
